model.name: modelStore.migrateIntoOneStoreAndPreserveResettability
model.description: Migrate every data/model-store unit into scenario/index (the ONE store) with zero data loss + no regression, and re-point every writer/reader off the second store; convert re-generate to idempotent-in-place / replace-by-deterministic-key / never-wipe-a-store so resettability survives without the 2nd store. One canonical owner afterwards.
model.note: Architect designs the migration mechanism + wires Class/Method on build-go (rides R40.81 relocate/collapse); tester captures the pre-migration baseline for AC-no-regression.
